review.tagline: Python framework for multi-agent workflows with role-based Crews and event-driven Flows
review.summary: CrewAI is a Python framework for building multi-agent workflows. Crews are teams of role-based agents with goals, tools and tasks, run sequentially or under a hierarchical manager. Flows are event-driven workflows with typed state, branching and routing that can embed Crews. A CLI scaffolds JSON-defined crew projects, with a classic YAML scaffold still available.
review.audience: Python developers building multi-agent LLM workflows in code
strengths: Two models: autonomous Crews and explicit Flows with state, branching and or_/and_ triggers
CLI scaffolds projects; agents and tasks declared in JSONC or classic YAML
Covers tools, memory, knowledge, checkpointing, async execution and MCP/A2A support
MIT license; recent commit and release within days of listing
weaknesses: Managed deployment, governance and enterprise support are in the commercial AMP Suite
README has a telemetry section; opt-out details are not in the excerpt
Requires Python >=3.10 and <3.14 and uv; Windows may need C++ build tools
Web search example needs a separate Serper.dev API key
needs: Needs Python >=3.10,<3.14, uv, LLM provider API key, Serper.dev API key (optional, web search)
Models: OpenAI (e.g. openai/gpt-4o), other providers via LLM setup
